description: Defines a SwiftUI wrapper for AppKit's NSVisualEffectView to enable visual effect customization in a macOS application.

classes.name: VisualEffectView
classes.description: A SwiftUI representable struct that wraps NSVisualEffectView to provide visual effects with customizable properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the VisualEffectView with specified visual effect properties.

methods.description: Creates and configures the NSVisualEffectView instance.

methods.description: Updates the existing NSVisualEffectView with current property values.
